title: Cleopatra Chaand Ke Zyada Kareeb Thi, Pyramid Ke Nahi!
idea: Cleopatra was born about 2,490 years after the Great Pyramid was finished, but only about 2,040 years before the Moon landing, so she lived closer in time to Apollo 11 than to the pyramid's construction.

lines.text: Cleopatra Chaand landing ke zyada kareeb thi, pyramid banne ke nahi!
Giza ka Great Pyramid bana 2560 BC mein, Taj Mahal se 4000+ saal pehle!
146 metre ooncha, aur 3800 saal tak duniya ki sabse oonchi building!
Cleopatra 69 BC mein paida hui, tab pyramid lagbhag 2500 saal purana tha!
Aur Cleopatra se Chaand landing 1969 tak? Sirf 2038 saal ka gap!
Cleopatra pyramid walon se zyada hamare kareeb thi! Yakeen hua? Comment karo!

facts.claim: The Great Pyramid of Giza was completed around 2560 BC and was originally about 146.6 m tall
The Great Pyramid stayed the tallest man-made structure until England's Lincoln Cathedral passed it in the early 1300s, which is more than 3,800 years
Cleopatra was born in 69 BC, about 2,491 years after the pyramid, and the Moon landing in 1969 came about 2,038 years after her birth
No credible pyramid date (scholarly range about 2480–2580 BCE) reverses the comparison
Taj Mahal construction began in 1632, more than 4,000 years after the Great Pyramid was completed around 2560 BC
